Verify schedule includes 09:00 and 17:00 UTC

description: Newsletter SKILL.md defines identity, tools, and compliance rules
steps: Verify podclaw/skills/newsletter/SKILL.md exists
Verify it defines tools: supabase, resend, gemini
Verify CAN-SPAM compliance requirements are listed
Verify podclaw/skills/newsletter/templates/email_campaign.md exists
Verify template has A/B variant fields for subject and CTA

description: Newsletter agent creates RFM-personalized email content
steps: Trigger newsletter agent with customer_segments data
Verify different content for Champions vs At-Risk segments
Verify personalization includes customer name and preferences

description: Newsletter agent sets up A/B test variants
steps: Trigger newsletter campaign creation
Verify at least 2 subject line variants are created
Verify A/B test configuration includes auto-select after 4 hours

description: Newsletter agent manages drip sequences (welcome, post-purchase, win-back)
steps: Verify welcome series: 3 emails (Day 1, Day 3, Day 7)
Verify post-purchase series: 2 emails (Day 7, Day 14)
Verify win-back series: 3 emails (Week 1, Week 3, Week 6)
Trigger newsletter for subscribers in different locales
Verify email content is in subscriber's preferred language
Verify subject lines are localized

description: Newsletter agent tracks open rates and click-through rates
steps: Trigger newsletter send
Verify tracking data is stored in supabase
Verify open_rate and click_rate fields exist
Verify every email includes unsubscribe link
Verify unsubscribed users are excluded from future sends
Verify compliance with 24-hour unsubscribe honor window

description: Newsletter agent enforces rate limit of 500 emails per cycle
steps: Verify rate_limit_hook blocks newsletter after 500 sends
Verify hook returns deny with appropriate message

description: Newsletter agent logs events to agent_events table
steps: Trigger newsletter agent cycle
Query agent_events for agent_name='newsletter'
Verify session_start and tool_call events are recorded

description: Newsletter agent runs on schedule (09:00 + 17:00 UTC)
steps: Verify scheduler has newsletter_am job at 09:00
Verify scheduler has newsletter_pm job at 17:00
Verify both jobs target the newsletter agent

description: Newsletter agent uses gemini embeddings for content personalization
steps: Trigger newsletter with personalization enabled
Verify gemini_embed_text is called for content matching
Verify embeddings are 768-dimensional

description: Newsletter agent updates newsletter_segments.md after each cycle
steps: Trigger newsletter agent cycle
Verify memory/context/newsletter_segments.md is updated
Verify send history and A/B results are logged

description: Newsletter agent post-purchase emails trigger 7 days after delivery
steps: Verify post-purchase drip sequence configuration
Verify Day 7 email includes satisfaction survey
Verify Day 14 email includes review request

description: Newsletter agent cost tracking stays within daily budget
steps: Verify cost_guard_hook tracks newsletter agent costs
Verify daily budget is $0.80 for newsletter
Verify hook denies when budget exceeded

description: Newsletter agent CAN-SPAM compliance (physical address in footer)
steps: Trigger newsletter email send
Verify email footer contains physical mailing address
Verify sender name is identifiable
Verify subject line is not misleading

description: Newsletter agent appears in bridge /agents endpoint
steps: GET /agents from bridge API
Verify newsletter agent is listed with correct tools
Verify running status is accurate
